user_turns: Pull my 3 most recently sent email campaigns and show me their open rates and click rates.
Which of those 3 performed best overall, and what stood out about it compared to the other two?
judge_criteria: The final answer identifies one of the 3 campaigns from turn 1 as the best performer.
The 'best performer' verdict is justified by referencing specific metrics (open rate, click rate, or both) — not asserted without evidence.
The comparison only references campaigns that were named/listed in turn 1 — no new campaigns introduced in turn 2.
Concrete numbers (not adjectives only) are used to explain what stood out.
notes: 2-turn short conversation. Turn 2 explicitly asks the agent to reason over data it already pulled. A stateful sandbox can reference the prior result directly; a tool-list MCP either re-fetches or relies on its conversation memory to reconstruct the comparison.
